quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

quotes.name: Revolutionary Rebuff
quotes.flavor: By the time a Consulate sanction becomes official, the renegade quicksmiths have already found a way to circumvent it.

quotes.name: Elfsworn Giant
quotes.flavor: He upheld his vow to the elves by watching their woods and blazing their trails.

quotes.name: Tireless Tribe
quotes.flavor: "We've survived starvation, dwarf attacks, and heatstroke. Why should a little sandstorm bother us?"

quotes.name: Voice of the Woods
quotes.flavor: "Ancient ones, I call on you, your wisdom and your power, your will to claim again all that is rightfully yours."

quotes.name: Alpharael, Stonechosen
quotes.flavor: "All things end. I'd rather embrace that truth than the fantasy of eternal light."

quotes.name: Innocent Blood
quotes.flavor: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

quotes.name: Dazzling Angel
quotes.flavor: Her wings ripple with impossible colors—a sign that a miracle is on the way.

quotes.name: Oona's Prowler
quotes.flavor: Deep in Glen Elendra blossoms Oona, queen of the faeries, nourished by secrets and pollinated by stolen dreams.

quotes.name: Hollowhead Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Brilliant! They evolved away from energy-taxing brains and respond only to spinal reflex arcs from the hive mind."
—Rukarumel, field journal

quotes.name: Nexos
quotes.flavor: The blessed union of gun, claw, and merciless intent is a force to be truly feared.

quotes.name: Strength in Numbers
quotes.flavor:
"The hermit dies. The outcast dies. The lone wolf dies. Only those who stick together survive this world."
—Uros, Pendelhaven elder

quotes.name: Antagonize
quotes.flavor:
"The little guy had guts at least. You can see 'em right there between those cobbles."
—Glunk, freelance crusher

quotes.name: Chandra's Defeat
quotes.flavor:
"Fire? Is that your only trick, Chandra?"
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Yenna, Redtooth Regent
quotes.flavor: "My people are both bloom and thorn."

quotes.name: Reforge the Soul
quotes.flavor: In a wave of spells called the Cursemute, Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire.

quotes.name: Maze Sentinel
quotes.flavor: The route has been known for millennia, but only by those with no means to tell it.

quotes.name: Terminate
quotes.flavor: All suns must set.

quotes.name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
quotes.flavor: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

quotes.name: Firebreathing
quotes.flavor:
"Magic's only part of it, my friend. Diet does the rest."
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

quotes.name: Witherbloom Apprentice
quotes.flavor: "All we are—every feeling, every action—powered by a single, delicate little organ. Life is so terrifyingly, beautifully fragile."

quotes.name: Honor of the Pure
quotes.flavor: Together the soldiers were like a golden blade, cutting down their enemies and scarring the darkness.

quotes.name: Thriving Isle
quotes.flavor: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

quotes.name: Happy Hogan, Dauntless Driver
quotes.flavor: "Traffic is a little heavy this morning, Tony, but we'll get you there on time."

quotes.name: Tale of Katara and Toph
quotes.flavor: "It's about time we did something fun together."

quotes.name: Waterlogged Grove
quotes.flavor: The trees pull water from deep underground, filling the forest for miles.

quotes.name: Birnin Zana Plaza
quotes.flavor: At the heart of Birnin Zana lies a monument to Bast and her chosen, the Black Panther.

quotes.name: Goldnight Commander
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: "One faith, but many hands in victory."

quotes.name: Stromkirk Patrol
quotes.flavor: "You'd best move along, human. Our palates are far less discerning than our master's."

quotes.name: Superior Spider-Man
quotes.flavor:
"I will be Spider-Man. With my unparalleled genius, I shall become the *Superior* Spider-Man."
—Otto Octavius

quotes.name: Merfolk Trickster
quotes.flavor: Saved from destruction by one planeswalker's sacrifice, the Eliterate colony forswore the taking of life.

quotes.name: Frontier Guide
quotes.flavor: "The elders say Zendikar has no safe, peaceful places. How would they know? They've never looked."

quotes.name: Silent-Chant Zubera
quotes.flavor: When the Honden of Cleansing Fire was abandoned, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to erode mortal will.

quotes.name: Sacred Nectar
quotes.flavor:
"Over the silver mountains,
Where spring the nectar fountains,
There will I kiss
The bowl of bliss;
And drink my everlasting fill. . . ."
—Sir Walter Raleigh, "The Pilgrimage"

quotes.name: Plains
quotes.flavor: You've traced the tensions in Ten-Towns to the dwindling reindeer populations ... but what has been hunting them?

quotes.name: Braided Net // Braided Quipu
quotes.flavor: The Oltec repurpose objects out of reverence rather than scarcity, believing them strengthened by the memory of each past function.

quotes.name: Your Plans Mean Nothing
quotes.flavor: "You will crawl through the ashes of your own grand ambitions before I grant you the mercy of death."

quotes.name: Liquimetal Coating
quotes.flavor:
"They'll soon become accustomed to wearing skin that is not their own."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

quotes.name: Frantic Search
quotes.flavor: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

quotes.name: Brago, King Eternal
quotes.flavor: "My rule persists beyond death itself."

quotes.name: Tenth District Veteran
quotes.flavor: "I keep reminding myself we do this because others can't, because we love this city. If we don't save it, no one will."

quotes.name: Sygg, River Cutthroat
quotes.flavor: "It's not a matter of deserving. It's a matter of strength. The power to hold versus the power to take."

quotes.name: Warmonger
quotes.flavor: Funny how money and war travel so well together.

quotes.name: Ronom Unicorn
quotes.flavor: The aberrant magic of the Rimewind drew the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle once again.

quotes.name: Swift Reconfiguration
quotes.flavor: On the bright side, the bear now had cupholders.

quotes.name: Goblin Diplomats
quotes.flavor: When you need to convey that special kind of message.

quotes.name: Loxodon Line Breaker
quotes.flavor: Loxodons are firm in stature and spirit. No matter the odds, they are always first into battle.

quotes.name: Harvester of Souls
quotes.flavor:
"He is judge, jury, and executioner because he killed them all."
—Bishop Cawle of Elgaud

quotes.name: Windborne Charge
quotes.flavor: The merfolk call the sky goddess Emeria. The kor call her Kamsa. The two races agree on little except that she offers many blessings to the faithful.

quotes.name: Luminous Angel
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: "The spread of evil's destruction shall always be matched by the rise of the noble fallen."

quotes.name: Kitchen Finks
quotes.flavor: Accept one favor from an ouphe, and you're doomed to accept another.

quotes.name: Zuran Spellcaster
quotes.flavor:
"A mage must be precise as well as potent; cautious, as well as clever."
—Zur the Enchanter

quotes.name: Deepchannel Mentor
quotes.flavor: The rivers can no longer provide safe passage for travelers and commerce. They serve only as highways for raiders and channels for blood and woe.

quotes.name: Sylvan Safekeeper
quotes.flavor:
"How could someone so small cause so much trouble?"
—Nomad sentry

quotes.name: Sergeant John Benton
quotes.flavor: "Anyway, nothing to do with you surprises me anymore, Doctor."

quotes.name: Zodiac Monkey
quotes.flavor: It lives mainly on fruit, leaves, and the occasional nose.

quotes.name: Skull Prophet
quotes.flavor: "I study bone because that's where truth dwells. One monster knucklebone is wiser than all that damp meat in your head."

quotes.name: Talisman of Unity
quotes.flavor: "How does the celery help?" asked Peri. "If the gas is present, the celery turns purple," replied the Doctor.

quotes.name: Rockfall Vale
quotes.flavor: Cries of panic echo along Kessig's narrow ravines as howlpacks herd their prey.

quotes.name: Unbreakable Bond
quotes.flavor:
From now until the crystals stop glowing
—Ketria oath meaning "forever"

quotes.name: Slash, Reptile Rampager
quotes.flavor: "Tell 'em you've got a new partner. One who knows the true meaning of being a warrior."

quotes.name: Lightning Bolt
quotes.flavor: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

quotes.name: Flowstone Blade
quotes.flavor:
"Remember the fable of the elf who came upon a cave of gold. In trying to free the largest piece, she was crushed by its weight."
—Karn

quotes.name: Judith, the Scourge Diva
quotes.flavor: At the end of the show, she stands alone on a stage brilliant with blood.

quotes.name: Dominion Supervisor
quotes.flavor: The loyal Vorta saw to the distribution of ketracel-white, the Dominion's powerful combination of narcotics and life-giving enzymes.

quotes.name: Sunrise Cavalier
quotes.flavor: "Like us, the morning fights for survival."

quotes.name: Sadistic Glee
quotes.flavor:
"First blood isn't as important as last blood."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Destructive Tampering
quotes.flavor:
"I don't think they'll appreciate my . . . adjustments."
—Karavin, renegade saboteur

quotes.name: Gods Willing
quotes.flavor: Honor the gods of Theros, and they will return the favor.

quotes.name: Blatant Thievery
quotes.flavor: Centuries of association with the Sun Empire have taught the dinosaurs that shiny things are important.

quotes.name: Angel's Feather
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: If taken, it cuts the hand that clutches it. If given, it heals the hand that holds it.

quotes.name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
quotes.flavor: "Hush now. I need your beauty sleep."

quotes.name: Shameless Charlatan
quotes.flavor: You see your next disguise in every stranger's smile.

quotes.name: Abrupt Decay
quotes.flavor: The Izzet quickly suspended their policy of lifetime guarantees.

quotes.name: Hulkling, Burgeoning Bruiser
quotes.flavor: "We all named ourselves after the original Avengers. I picked the Hulk. Be honest. Wouldn't you?"

quotes.name: Birds of Paradise
quotes.flavor: It is rumored that wild breeds of the species— including those which have retained the capacity for flight—still thrive throughout forests nestled in the vastly unexplored valleys of Abalathia's Spine.

quotes.name: So Tiny
quotes.flavor: His sword sounded like a silver chime on the glass jar, and the sprite laughed with delight.

quotes.name: Impatience
quotes.flavor: "I'm going to count to three. Three."

quotes.name: Strix Lookout
quotes.flavor: Wise. Watchful. Fashionable.

quotes.name: Last March of the Ents
quotes.flavor:
"To Isengard with doom we come!
With doom we come, with doom we come!"

quotes.name: City of Solitude
quotes.flavor:
"My horizon was the arcing petals, my new home resplendent with spires of weeds and pillows of fragrant pollen."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

quotes.name: Smoldering Marsh
quotes.flavor:
"What's so great about seeing a volcano? It's just a sort of leaky mountain."
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Triskelion
quotes.flavor: A brainchild of Tawnos, the Triskelion later proved both versatile and useful.

quotes.name: Mirran Crusader
quotes.flavor: A symbol of what Mirrodin once was and hope for what it will be again.

quotes.name: Goblin Assault Team
quotes.flavor: Under the veneer of the various guilds, each goblin has the same basic need: to run screaming at the enemy and hit a bunch of stuff.

quotes.name: Ranger's Longbow
quotes.flavor: With the right weapon, a fearsome beholder is nothing more than a big floating bullseye.

quotes.name: Golgari Signet
quotes.flavor: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

quotes.name: Wallop
quotes.flavor: In Yavimaya, flying low to join a battle can be a costly mistake.

quotes.name: Might Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"The colossal thing rumbled over the ridge, tree husks crumbling before it. The ones we were already fighting howled as it came, their muscles suddenly surging, and we knew it was time to flee."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

quotes.name: James, Wandering Dad // Follow Him
quotes.flavor: "So long as we've got each other, that's all that matters."

quotes.name: Craw Wurm
quotes.flavor: The most terrifying thing about the Craw Wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

quotes.name: Feast of the Unicorn
quotes.flavor:
"Could there be a fouler act? No doubt the Baron knows of one."
—Autumn Willow

quotes.name: Liliana's Elite
quotes.flavor:
"You have to admit, Gideon—he has great form."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Servo Schematic
quotes.flavor: The Consulate prizes innovation when it is dependable and replicable.

quotes.name: Talas Researcher
quotes.flavor:
From time, knowledge.
From knowledge, power.

quotes.name: Psychic Barrier
quotes.flavor:
"I tolerate Phyrexians because the dragon requires it. But I have no patience for uninvited guests."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Dawnglare Invoker
quotes.flavor:
"What we knew as Emeria, Ula, and Cosi were not divine beings at all, but a cruel trick, and a grave error."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

quotes.name: Biolume Egg // Biolume Serpent
quotes.flavor: Serpents leave their eggs in the cold and inky depths...

quotes.name: Brainwash
quotes.flavor: "They're not your friends; they despise you. I'm the only one you can count on. Trust me."

quotes.name: Omenspeaker
quotes.flavor: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.

quotes.name: Fungal Plots
quotes.flavor: Thallids nurture saprolings, entertain them, and eat them.

quotes.name: Filigree Attendant
quotes.flavor:
"The perfect assistant is one that's responsive, dextrous, and capable of reaching all the high shelves."
—Coruk, Esper artificer

quotes.name: Seer's Sundial
quotes.flavor: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

quotes.name: Indestructibility
quotes.flavor: "By all means, keep trying."

quotes.name: Three Visits
quotes.flavor:
"The strands of the Great Web have converged on a new world that needs our protection."
—Ghost-Spider, Gwen Stacy

quotes.name: Muscle Sliver
quotes.flavor: The air was filled with the cracks and snaps of flesh hardening as the new sliver joined the battle.

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor:
"Run. Run, you clever boy. And remember."
—Clara Oswald

quotes.name: Repeal
quotes.flavor:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

quotes.name: Caught in the Brights
quotes.flavor: While hunting aether, a gremlin may ignore other stimuli, including threats to its own life.

quotes.name: Trickster Mage
quotes.flavor: "If it ain't broke, I'll break it. If it *is* broke, I'll fix it."

quotes.name: Inquisition of Kozilek
quotes.flavor: You will scream out your innermost secrets just to make it stop.

quotes.name: Search for Azcanta // Azcanta, the Sunken Ruin
quotes.flavor: The Sunken Ruin houses all the learning of a long-forgotten age.

quotes.name: Goblin Wardriver
quotes.flavor:
"A true warrior fights with whatever's handy."
—Qerk of the Secret Warren

quotes.name: Strict Proctor
quotes.flavor: "You might believe being dead for centuries has made me more lenient. I think you'll find the opposite to be true."

quotes.name: Chambered Nautilus
quotes.flavor: What's merely a home for the nautilus can become exquisite jewelry in the hands of Saprazzan artisans.

quotes.name: Selesnya Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.

quotes.name: Lava Spike
quotes.flavor: "If the stabbing doesn't get ya, the melting sure will."

quotes.name: Merfolk Pupil
quotes.flavor: Maintaining a personal bubble is even more important when you have gills.

quotes.name: Tenth District Guard
quotes.flavor: "The Tenth has always been my home. This city is constantly embroiled in one crisis or another, but I'm determined to protect my piece."

quotes.name: Coalition Victory
quotes.flavor:
"You can build a perfect machine out of imperfect parts."
—Urza

quotes.name: Elvish Warrior
quotes.flavor: "My tales of war are the stories most asked for around the fires at night, but they're the ones I care least to tell."

quotes.name: Firebolt
quotes.flavor: Reach out and torch someone.

quotes.name: War Mammoth
quotes.flavor: I didn't think Mammoths could ever hold a candle to a well-trained battle horse. Then one day I turned my back on a drunken soldier. His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

quotes.name: Mind Shatter
quotes.flavor: Dark thoughts hatch and twist within the mind, straining to take wing.

quotes.name: Baloth Gorger
quotes.flavor: A baloth only cares about the many things it eats and the few things that eat it.

quotes.name: Graven Cairns
quotes.flavor: Shamans of Kar-Sengir claim that their sun sets because it can no longer bear the gaze of those pain-carved cliffs.

quotes.name: Lembas
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: They could eat of it and find new strength even as they ran.

quotes.name: Sulfurous Mire
quotes.flavor:
"In my youth, we used to best each other at hopping rabbit-fast between the lava spouts, the burning tar spattering our legs."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

quotes.name: Bola Warrior
quotes.flavor: The ingredients for panic include equal parts danger, uncertainty, and helplessness.

quotes.name: Copperline Gorge
quotes.flavor: Where the Tangle overruns the Oxidda mountains, metallic beasts scratch their territories in the verdigris.

quotes.name: Runic Armasaur
quotes.flavor: The Sun Empire's most sacred sites are protected by more than prayers.

quotes.name: Unexplained Disappearance
quotes.flavor: The first thing the mist chills is the mind. Victims never cry out or even murmur in surprise.

quotes.name: Federation Field Medic
quotes.flavor: "Stop whining. Sto-Vo-Kor will be there later."

quotes.name: Mutinous Massacre
quotes.flavor: Kavaron's degradation poisoned many hearts, which the Monoists were happy to exploit.

quotes.name: Pacifism
quotes.flavor: "Can't a fella get a moment's peace around here?"

quotes.name: Ruthless Winnower
quotes.flavor: "I count the usurpers with my dagger, one death blow at a time."

quotes.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
quotes.flavor: An angel among angels, she carries the hopes of the world skyward.

quotes.name: Ancient Ziggurat
quotes.flavor: Built in honor of Alara's creatures, the ziggurat vanished long ago. When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

quotes.name: The Blue Spirit
quotes.flavor: To the Avatar, was the Blue Spirit a friend? A foe? Or something else entirely?

quotes.name: Knight of New Alara
quotes.flavor: "I embrace all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant. Let my former home call me traitor. I do this not for accolades, but because it is right."

quotes.name: Sandsteppe Citadel
quotes.flavor: That which endures, survives.

quotes.name: Legion's Judgment
quotes.flavor: "My lance was once wielded by Venerable Tarrian. In his name and by his might, I cast you down!"

quotes.name: Unyielding Krumar
quotes.flavor: "The man whom I call father killed the orc who sired me, offering his world and his blade in return."

quotes.name: Reckless Impulse
quotes.flavor: A stitcher looks at their creation and sees the result of years of study and hours of toil. A devil sees a new plaything.

quotes.name: Dragonskull Summit
quotes.flavor:
"Now the great cloud hangs over all the land between here and the Mountains of Shadow; and it is deepening. War has already begun."
—Errand-rider of Gondor

quotes.name: Dreaded Bat-Cloud
quotes.flavor: Beneath the thunder another blackness whirled forward, so dense that no light could be seen between their wings.

quotes.name: Sea's Claim
quotes.flavor:
"Who's the crazy one now!?"
—Torgle, mountaintop boatmaker

quotes.name: Call of the Death-Dweller
quotes.flavor: The living fear Nethroi's whispers. The dead heed them.

quotes.name: Goblin Festival
quotes.flavor: "What are we celebratin' again?"

quotes.name: Darksteel Citadel
quotes.flavor: Panopticon, forge of the Darksteel Eye, home of Mirrodin's keeper.

quotes.name: Kelpie Guide
quotes.flavor: Kelpies are drawn to paradoxes, making them ideal companions for Quandrix mages.

quotes.name: Soul of the Harvest
quotes.flavor: It's there when a seed sprouts, when gourds ripen on the vines, and when the reapers cut the grains under the Harvest Moon.

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor: A relic that greatly enhances the magical power of its wielder.

quotes.name: Overgrown Battlement
quotes.flavor:
"Our enemy is nothing less than the end of all life. We shall not want for allies."
—*The War Diaries*

quotes.name: Temple of Deceit
quotes.flavor:
"No one's called it Satellite Five in ages. It's the Game Station now."
—Lynda

quotes.name: Reckless Endeavor
quotes.flavor:
"Bad fish. It's not like going down t'the pond chasin' blue gills or tommycods. This shark? Swallow ya whole."
—Quint

quotes.name: Execute
quotes.flavor:
"Any fool who would die for honor is better off dead."
—Cabal Patriarch

quotes.name: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen
quotes.flavor: His spark lost, he plots revenge upon the plane whose corrupting mana fractured his soul.

quotes.name: Gene Pollinator
quotes.flavor: Eumidians have engineered a device or species to manage every stage of terrasymbiosis.

quotes.name: Baloth Woodcrasher
quotes.flavor: Its insatiable hunger quickly depletes a region of prey. It must migrate from place to place to feed its massive bulk.

quotes.name: Defiant Strike
quotes.flavor:
"For twelve days and twelve nights, Somat assailed the monster's shell. On the thirteenth morning, it cracked with the dawn."
—*Heroics: A Book of Fables*

quotes.name: Inspiring Statuary
quotes.flavor: Ghirapur's most celebrated inventors have been immortalized in clockwork.

quotes.name: Wall of Granite
quotes.flavor: The wisest man builds his house *behind* the rock.

quotes.name: Sylvan Caryatid
quotes.flavor: "We are the Junimos... Keepers of the forest."

quotes.name: Chaotic Backlash
quotes.flavor: The concept of thoughtweft fascinates the Nighthearth cult. Imagine, bringing agony to an entire people by torturing just one.

quotes.name: Evie Frye
quotes.flavor: "For every mission, there is a right way and a wrong way. Barging thoughtlessly into combat is, more often than not, the latter."

quotes.name: Gravedigger
quotes.flavor: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

quotes.name: Tanufel Rimespeaker
quotes.flavor: "A single snowflake can trigger an avalanche. A single insight can do the same."

quotes.name: Goblin Digging Team
quotes.flavor: "From down here we can make the whole wall collapse!" "Uh, yeah, boss, but how do we get out?"

quotes.name: Brindle Shoat
quotes.flavor: Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.

quotes.name: Count on Luck
quotes.flavor: "With your help, Loot, we're going to make a hell of an entrance," said Chandra. In less than fifteen minutes, she came to regret those words.

quotes.name: Goblin Trailblazer
quotes.flavor:
"Why are we following the goblin? Can he even read that map?"
—Daphne Vail, *Diremore* first mate

quotes.name: Raze to the Ground
quotes.flavor: First one, then a second, then a third of the ivory towers fell to the invaders, who moved in a circle around the city like an apocalyptic clock.

quotes.name: Chart a Course
quotes.flavor: As the River Heralds began to decipher the ancient map, they were staggered by the vastness of the world-within-the-world that it revealed.

quotes.name: Dorothea, Vengeful Victim // Dorothea's Retribution
quotes.flavor: "Every day a Voldaren draws breath is a day I cannot rest."

quotes.name: Scryb Sprites
quotes.flavor: The only sound was the gentle clicking of the Faeries' wings. Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled. One thing was certain: they didn't think the Scryb were very funny anymore.

quotes.name: Nekrataal
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My Betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say."
—Jolrael

quotes.name: Kird Ape
quotes.flavor: It puts the "fur" in "fury."

quotes.name: Gideon's Reproach
quotes.flavor:
"Suddenly, Gideon was there with us, clearing the way so that we could escape."
—*The War Diaries*

quotes.name: Sun-Spider, Nimble Webber
quotes.flavor: Breaking expectations and enjoying it.

quotes.name: Jund Panorama
quotes.flavor: The sky is the dragon's throne, the seat from which it issues its fiery decrees.

quotes.name: Vampiric Tutor
quotes.flavor: "I can tell you what you wish to know. But first, there is the matter of my fee."

quotes.name: Y'shtola Rhul
quotes.flavor: "As I suspected, the aetheric disturbance here is no natural occurrence."

quotes.name: Choking Sands
quotes.flavor:
"The people wiped the sand from their eyes and cursed—and left the barren land to the hyenas and vipers."
—Afari, *Tales*

quotes.name: Peerless Samurai
quotes.flavor: "I fear I have run out of worthy opponents."

quotes.name: Spectacular Pileup
quotes.flavor: The first four crashes were accidental. Then the Endriders joined the fun.

quotes.name: Pit Trap
quotes.flavor: Yotian soldiers were designed to fight, not watch their feet.

quotes.name: Executioner's Capsule
quotes.flavor: There is always a moment of trepidation before opening a message capsule, for fear of the judgment that might be contained within.

quotes.name: Scalelord Reckoner
quotes.flavor: The justice of dragons demands more than just an eye for an eye.

quotes.name: Pacifism
quotes.flavor:
"If only they'd all act this docile. I could do something relaxing for a living. I've always wanted to bake biscuits."
—Ethuk, Coppercoat mage

quotes.name: Axgard Cavalry
quotes.flavor:
Riding the goat
—Dwarven expression meaning
"a foolhardy act of bravery"

quotes.name: Toxic Deluge
quotes.flavor: Even Sam's vision in the Mirror had not prepared him. The Old Grange on the west side had been knocked down, and its place taken by rows of tarred sheds. All the chestnuts were gone. The banks and hedgerows were broken.

quotes.name: Drudge Beetle
quotes.flavor: The Street Swarm is the labor class that drives the Golgari's endless cycle of life and death.

quotes.name: Warrior's Honor
quotes.flavor:
"No person was ever honored for what he received. Honor has been the reward for what he gave."
—Calvin Coolidge

quotes.name: Ketramose, the New Dawn
quotes.flavor: Let the past die so the future might live.

quotes.name: Bloom Tender
quotes.flavor: "What, these old things? They were just lying around, gathering dust. I figured I might as well put them to use."

quotes.name: Worn Powerstone
quotes.flavor: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

quotes.name: Sibilant Spirit
quotes.flavor: She had expected death to roar, to thunder, to growl. She did not recognize it when it came hissing to her side.

quotes.name: Ragged Recluse // Odious Witch
quotes.flavor: "Forgive my manners. It's been so long since I had a guest for dinner."

quotes.name: Spectacular Spider-Man
quotes.flavor: The Spider-Armor MK I Suit

quotes.name: Mark of Mutiny
quotes.flavor: The flame of anger is hard to douse once lit.

quotes.name: Ad Nauseam
quotes.flavor: When the task spilled over into undeath, he stopped calling it his life's work.

quotes.name: Mortivore
quotes.flavor: The light sigh of its breath whistles through its bones.

quotes.name: Sculpting Steel
quotes.flavor: An artificer once dropped one in a vault full of coins. She has yet to find it.

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

quotes.name: Insidious Will
quotes.flavor:
"We meet again, pyromancer."
—Baral, Chief of Compliance

quotes.name: Expedition Map
quotes.flavor:
"I use maps to find out where explorers have already been. Then I go the other way."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

quotes.name: Kishla Skimmer
quotes.flavor: "Rising waters have flooded many old places from the dragon's rule. I do not miss them."

quotes.name: Teysa, Orzhov Scion
quotes.flavor: "Spend your life betraying me if you wish. I'll simply take it up with your ghost."

quotes.name: Evangel of Synthesis
quotes.flavor: "Forge the future in metal and oil!"

quotes.name: Frenzied Saddlebrute
quotes.flavor: The drumbeats of the horde echo in every heart.

quotes.name: Skyshroud Vampire
quotes.flavor:
"If it tastes one drop of elvish blood I will cast it from the shroud to see it burn."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

quotes.name: Lotho, Corrupt Shirriff
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Whatever is wrong in the Shire, Lotho will be at the bottom of it: you can be sure of that."
—Pippin

quotes.name: Knight of the Kitchen Sink
quotes.flavor: "Whew. For a minute, I thought I'd forgotten the tea cozy."

quotes.name: Act of Treason
quotes.flavor:
"Rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Living End
quotes.flavor:
「死とは贈り物。終わりの訪れを知る中に、安らぎがあるの。」
――「屍術に関するヴェスから忠告」

quotes.name: Supernatural Stamina
quotes.flavor:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

quotes.name: Noxious Dragon
quotes.flavor: Dragons of Silumgar's brood begin to digest their prey even before consuming it, letting their caustic breath do much of the work.

quotes.name: Full Throttle
quotes.flavor:
"You wanted a fight. Now you've got two."
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Extravagant Replication
quotes.flavor: "Just one aether tiger? What do I look like, a peasant?"

quotes.name: Parker Luck
quotes.flavor: "Things have gotta go my way eventually, right?"

quotes.name: Ley Druid
quotes.flavor: After years of training, the Druid becomes one with nature, drawing power from the land and returning it when needed.

quotes.name: Qasali Slingers
quotes.flavor: All things will crumble, whether by time or by force.

quotes.name: Pristine Skywise
quotes.flavor: The elite of Ojutai's brood, the skywise see their enemies as puzzles to be solved.

quotes.name: Steel Overseer
quotes.flavor: "Welcome, Administrator. Targeting Parameters have been erased and set to ADMIN_USER_GROUP• <Token. Name=Faction>."

quotes.name: Oneirophage
quotes.flavor: It manifests at wizard academies to siphon inspiration from young prodigies.

quotes.name: Venerable Monk
quotes.flavor: Age wears the flesh but galvanizes the soul.

quotes.name: Nocturnal Raid
quotes.flavor: The Eastern Paladin doesn't attack at night for the tactical advantage. He does it for the sheer joy of fighting beneath the moon.

quotes.name: Opportunity
quotes.flavor: "Opportunity isn't something you wait for. It's something you create."

quotes.name: Spiteflame Witch
quotes.flavor: Cinder beliefs revolve around the Path of Sorrow, a spiritual descent into oblivion. They don't mind taking others on their journey down.

quotes.name: Frost Bite
quotes.flavor:
"Don't wander far—it's a bit nippy out there!"
—Leidurr, expedition leader

quotes.name: Barbflare Gremlin
quotes.flavor:
"You think burning the pie to a crisp was bad? You should see what it did to the chef!"
—Meg, supply runner

quotes.name: Unwinding Clock
quotes.flavor:
"The partisans have unearthed a strange artifact. None know its origin, but it gives them hope of a life beyond."
—Elspeth's journal

quotes.name: Reki, the History of Kamigawa
quotes.flavor:
"After his death, monks spent ten years transcribing the tattoos from Reki's body and gathering stories from those who spoke with him. Thus the volume you hold was written."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Insolence
quotes.flavor:
"Sacrificing mortal dragons to satisfy your immortal hunger ends here."
—Darigaaz, to Rith

quotes.name: Gilded Lotus
quotes.flavor:
"They're a lot tougher than they look. This place... It has a kind of power."
—Aerith Gainsborough

quotes.name: Knucklebone Witch
quotes.flavor: Each bone honors its owner's best pranks.

quotes.name: Rain of Filth
quotes.flavor:
"When I say it rained, it was not small drops, but a thick, greasy drool pouring from the heavens."
—Urza, journal

quotes.name: Brightclimb Pathway // Grimclimb Pathway
quotes.flavor:
"Why risk life and limb exploring the wilds? For this."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Enchantress's Presence
quotes.flavor: "The wise learn from successes as well as mistakes."

quotes.name: Ajani's Pridemate
quotes.flavor:
"We must never stoop to violence in the name of conquest or hatred, but when evil threatens, we must face it with courage and ferocity."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Ultimecia, Time Sorceress // Ultimecia, Omnipotent
quotes.flavor: "Your vain krusade ends here, SeeDs."

quotes.name: Catapult Squad
quotes.flavor: Together they could hit anything between the heavens and the horizon.

quotes.name: Pact of the Serpent
quotes.flavor: "Our quarrels behind us. Our foes before us. Death or triumph for us all!"

quotes.name: Temple of Plenty
quotes.flavor: Pre-owned, pre-rusted, pre-irradiated.

quotes.name: Brushland
quotes.flavor:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Three Visits
quotes.flavor:
"Trying to meet a worthy man in the wrong way is as bad as closing the door on an invited guest."
—Mencius, a Chinese philosopher

quotes.name: Audience with Trostani
quotes.flavor: Trostani was as regal and vibrant as ever, but Kaya couldn't shake the sense that there was something off, some discordant note lurking deep within the chorus.

quotes.name: Polymorphist's Jest
quotes.flavor:
"The flies were bothering me."
—Jalira, master polymorphist

quotes.name: Herbology Instructor // Malady Invoker
quotes.flavor: "As you see, these flowers . . . can have either restorative or poisonous . . . what is that?"

quotes.name: Hamato Guardian Stance
quotes.flavor: "Everything you know, I have shown you, but I have not shown you everything I know."

quotes.name: Prismari Pianist
quotes.flavor: He'd practiced his scales specifically for this moment.

quotes.name: Pia's Revolution
quotes.flavor: Pia's passion was directed at the big picture—at making real, lasting change.

quotes.name: Cryptcaller Chariot
quotes.flavor:
"They too deserve to witness Amonkhet's rebirth."
—Zahur

quotes.name: Well of Lost Dreams
quotes.flavor: Some say the knowledge lost during the Ritual of Rebuking is returned through the well's waters.

quotes.name: Killing Wave
quotes.flavor:
"I come looking for demons and I find a plane full of angels. I hate angels."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Haunted House
quotes.flavor: To build Sorin's Haunted Mansion, every detail of Markov Manor was painstakingly recreated, from the floating laser ghosts to the robot space gargoyles.

quotes.name: The Master, Gallifrey's End
quotes.flavor: "A perfect army, right? Right? Oh, come in, my pretties!"

quotes.name: Incursion Specialist
quotes.flavor: "Work for the Dimir again? That depends. Tell me more about this maze."

quotes.name: Rubblebelt Raiders
quotes.flavor:
"This city will perish, and the Gruul will cheer as the boar-god crushes the last bricks into dust."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

quotes.name: Deadly Insect
quotes.flavor: With his newfound sense of self-importance, Squee set his sights on ever-bigger bugs.

quotes.name: Wooden Sphere
quotes.flavor: Strengthened by a thousand limbs.

quotes.name: Nessian Asp
quotes.flavor: It's not the two heads you should fear. It's the four fangs.

quotes.name: Make a Stand
quotes.flavor: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

quotes.name: Archaeomancer
quotes.flavor: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

quotes.name: Rest for the Weary
quotes.flavor: Zendikar is a brutal taskmaster, but sometimes it offers unexpected solace.

quotes.name: Electro's Bolt
quotes.flavor:
"Hey Max, while you're at it, do you mind charging my phone?"
—Spider-Man

quotes.name: Sythis, Harvest's Hand
quotes.flavor: "Through every verdant field, every bough that hangs heavy with fruit, Karametra shows her love."

quotes.name: Steady Progress
quotes.flavor: "More of that strange oil . . . It's probably nothing."

quotes.name: Sage Owl
quotes.flavor: The owl asks but never answers.

quotes.name: Orzhov Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"We do not believe in hiding our wealth in the shadows. This is Orzhov, and this is how we reward greatness."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

quotes.name: Gravecrawler
quotes.flavor:
"Innistrad's ghoulcallers are talented enough, but let me show you what someone with real power can create."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Vein Ripper
quotes.flavor: IDENTITY UNKNOWN. BODY COUNT UNKNOWN BUT POTENTIALLY IN THE DOZENS.

quotes.name: Blanchwood Armor
quotes.flavor:
"There's never been a dwarven smith who could match the marvels that Gaea herself forges."
—Elvish champion

quotes.name: Temporal Extortion
quotes.flavor: "Let us start a new reign of terror. I will let you live a fantasy beyond your imagination."

quotes.name: Voltaic Key
quotes.flavor: The key did not work on a single lock, yet it opened many doors.

quotes.name: Withdraw
quotes.flavor: "We outnumber them! Charge! Charge! Hey, where'd you guys go? Retreat! Retreat!"

quotes.name: Infernal Kirin
quotes.flavor: The kirin bellowed—an echoing, twisted parody of its once-inspirational call.

quotes.name: Char
quotes.flavor: Izzet mages often acquire their magic reagents from dubious sources, so the potency of their spells is never predictable.

quotes.name: Confiscate
quotes.flavor:
"The surface world contains nothing I cannot take."
—The Lord of Atlantis

quotes.name: Winds of Rath
quotes.flavor:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Great Furnace
quotes.flavor: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

quotes.name: Sulfur Falls
quotes.flavor: Shortly after the vault dwellers moved out, fire geckos moved in.

quotes.name: Foreboding Ruins
quotes.flavor: When the Great Rift opened across the Galaxy, many Imperial worlds were lost to Chaos.

quotes.name: Birds of Paradise
quotes.flavor: Sages whisper of an undiscovered natural paradise, a tropical island unspoiled by war.

quotes.name: Luminarch Aspirant
quotes.flavor: "Rally to my light, and together we will drive out this darkness!"

quotes.name: Shaile, Dean of Radiance // Embrose, Dean of Shadow
quotes.flavor: "You are so much stronger than you know."

quotes.name: Ornithopter
quotes.flavor:
"It has been my honor to improve on the Thran's original design. Perhaps history will remember me in some small part for my work."
—Urza, in his apprenticeship

quotes.name: Rethink
quotes.flavor: "Are you *sure* you want to do that?"

quotes.name: Wyleth, Soul of Steel
quotes.flavor: "Two things a warrior needs: a strong sword and a strong will."

quotes.name: Peach Garden Oath
quotes.flavor:
"We three, though of separate ancestry, join in brotherhood. . . . We dare not hope to be together always but hereby vow to die the selfsame day."
—Peach Garden Oath

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

quotes.name: Kaervek, the Spiteful
quotes.flavor: "Defy me and I will burn the flesh from your bones. Betray me and I will steal the breath from your lungs."

quotes.name: Pillage
quotes.flavor:
"Were they to reduce us to ash, we would clog their throats and sting their eyes in payment."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

quotes.name: Abandon the Post
quotes.flavor: You don't have to outrun the werewolf; you only have to outrun your fellow guard.

quotes.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
quotes.flavor: "I serve the soft light of the moon that holds back the terrors of the night. I serve the bonds between us, driving out the fear that would break us apart."

quotes.name: Shady Traveler // Stalking Predator
quotes.flavor: The stranger spoke to no one, and the townspeople gladly returned the favor.

quotes.name: Healing Leaves
quotes.flavor: The elves of Llanowar don't trust in alchemy. They rely instead on pure herbs harvested from the forest's sacred heart.

quotes.name: Victimize
quotes.flavor:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Flame of Anor
quotes.flavor: There was a ringing clash and a stab of white fire, and the Balrog fell back.

quotes.name: Unsummon
quotes.flavor:
"You're trespassing in my reality. Ask permission next time."
—Simun the Quiet

quotes.name: Abyssal Persecutor
quotes.flavor: His slaves crave death more than they desire freedom. He denies them both.

quotes.name: Rescuer Chwinga
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Fortunately for lost travelers, chwingas' curiosity often gets the better of their shyness.

quotes.name: Growth Spiral
quotes.flavor:
"We're capable of the most incredible change. We can evolve while still staying true to who we are. We can honor who we've been and choose who we want to be next."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

quotes.name: Hinterland Hermit // Hinterland Scourge
quotes.flavor: He tried to live far from those he could hurt . . .

quotes.name: Crypt Incursion
quotes.flavor: Suddenly a song began: a cold murmur, rising and falling, grim, cold, heartless and miserable. The night was railing against the morning of which it was bereaved, and the cold was cursing the warmth for which it hungered.

quotes.name: Prismatic Omen
quotes.flavor: In times of portent, the land sculpts itself in accordance with the sigils burned on the sky.

quotes.name: Indulgent Tormentor
quotes.flavor: The promise of anguish is payment enough for services rendered.

quotes.name: Kiddie Coaster
quotes.flavor:
"The coaster was so gentle, I was able to write my review while I was still on it."
—*Salzon's Ride Review*

quotes.name: Angelic Blessing
quotes.flavor: Only the warrior who can admit mortal weakness will be bolstered by immortal strength.

quotes.name: Smitten Swordmaster // Curry Favor
quotes.flavor: "My quest? Why, to marry Ayara. Or die trying."

quotes.name: Dragonloft Idol
quotes.flavor: The idols were forged during the time of the Khanfall, when the dragons came to rule Tarkir and its people aligned themselves with the five dragonlords.

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

quotes.name: Kykar, Wind's Fury
quotes.flavor: "The raging gale fans the flames of righteous wrath."

quotes.name: Basilisk Collar
quotes.flavor: A mark of companionship, not subservience.

quotes.name: Akiri, Fearless Voyager
quotes.flavor: "No angel bars our ascent. Emeria waits above!"

quotes.name: Eater of Days
quotes.flavor: When Mirrodin's varied civilizations developed ways to fight the levelers, Memnarch upped the stakes.

quotes.name: Sphere of Law
quotes.flavor: Law smothers anarchy.

quotes.name: Reflexes
quotes.flavor:
"Be as fast as lightning, and you will be just as deadly."
—Combat trainer

quotes.name: Dreamroot Cascade
quotes.flavor:
"The Medusa Cascade. I came here when I was just a kid, ninety years old."
—The Tenth Doctor

quotes.name: Charging Rhino
quotes.flavor: The knights of Troinir Keep took the rhino as their emblem due to its intense focus when charging down a perceived threat—a trait they discovered on a hunting excursion.

quotes.name: Bovine Intervention
quotes.flavor: After the Skrull invasion of Earth was thwarted, they volunteered to do no more harm in exchange for a peaceful life.

quotes.name: Gaddock Teeg
quotes.flavor: So great is his wisdom and spirit that many who have met him say that they stood before a giant of a man and talked to the wisest of the four winds.

quotes.name: Scion of the Ur-Dragon
quotes.flavor: "I am the blood of the ur-dragon, coursing through all dragonkind."

quotes.name: Quasiduplicate
quotes.flavor: "My greatest creation—me!"

quotes.name: Morkrut Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"Let's see my brother's stitched-up little toys compete with this."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Pattern Matcher
quotes.flavor:
"Good! Now put it with the other widdle bunnies."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

quotes.name: Ancient Craving
quotes.flavor: Knowledge demands sacrifice.

quotes.name: Prowling Pangolin
quotes.flavor: "Wait, are *we* the decoys?"

quotes.name: Marcus, Mutant Mayor
quotes.flavor: "Welcome to Jacobstown, human. You're free to walk around. Just don't stare at the nightkin."

quotes.name: Aura Shards
quotes.flavor: Gaea forged her soldiers into self-wielding weapons that struck down all impurities.

quotes.name: Fractured Powerstone
quotes.flavor: The Thran learned to capture mana, but power inevitably escapes its bonds.

quotes.name: Grave Pact
quotes.flavor:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

quotes.name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
quotes.flavor: Spilled blood always begets more of the same.

quotes.name: Desertion
quotes.flavor: First the insult, then the injury.

quotes.name: Izzet Signet
quotes.flavor: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

quotes.name: Stomper Cub
quotes.flavor:
"This one is only a yearling, but it would be wise to move away before we provide it with excellent hunting practice."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Grizzly Bears
quotes.flavor: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

quotes.name: Argivian Phalanx
quotes.flavor: New Argive welcomed the kor people when they were displaced by the Rathi overlay. The kor repay that kindness with fierce loyalty.

quotes.name: Beast Whisperer
quotes.flavor: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

quotes.name: Bloodthirsty Conqueror
quotes.flavor: "Your death will be neither quick nor painless. Agony makes blood so much sweeter."

quotes.name: Kranioceros
quotes.flavor:
"A surly beast, the kranioceros will raise its defenses at the smallest threat. Stay out of sight and downwind, or you'll disrupt its natural migrations."
—Ebrel, godtoucher mentor

quotes.name: Sandstorm
quotes.flavor: Even the landscape turned against Sarsour, first rising up and pelting him, then rearranging itself so he could no longer find his way.

quotes.name: Choked Estuary
quotes.flavor:
"My body may be imprisoned on the Isle of Silence, but my magic is free to seek revenge!"
—Loki

quotes.name: True Polymorph
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: Maybe a little *too* convincing.

quotes.name: The Tarrasque
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: When it rises, nations fall.

quotes.name: Gurmag Angler
quotes.flavor: If everything in the Gurmag Swamp hungers for human flesh, what bait could be more effective?

quotes.name: Sage of the Skies
quotes.flavor: "Gravity is just a suggestion."

quotes.name: Rosheen Meanderer
quotes.flavor: Night after night, Rosheen babbled about a bygone sunlit world, her every word dismissed as a madwoman's ravings.

quotes.name: True Polymorph
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: Maybe a little *too* convincing.

quotes.name: Nameless One
quotes.flavor: "Open your mind to me."

quotes.name: Gadwick, the Wizened
quotes.flavor: His name is spoken only in whispers—but he hears just the same.

quotes.name: Disenchant
quotes.flavor:
The scepter of power is fragile in a calloused hand.
—Cho-Arrim saying

quotes.name: Seal of Removal
quotes.flavor:
"I am the unraveler, the loosened thread that will not hold."
—Seal inscription

quotes.name: Mask of Law and Grace
quotes.flavor: The archangels zealously drove Serra's light into every corner of their new home as if their creator still commanded them.

quotes.name: Horned Turtle
quotes.flavor:
"So like men are they: a hardened shell with fragile flesh beneath."
—Selenia, dark angel

quotes.name: Leatherback Baloth
quotes.flavor: Heavy enough to withstand the Roil, leatherback skeletons are havens for travelers in storms and landshifts.

quotes.name: Crumbling Necropolis
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: It's said the spirits of the drowned dead hang their lights from the shattered figureheads.

quotes.name: Diabolic Tutor
quotes.flavor: The best ideas often come from the worst minds.

quotes.name: Quagmire Druid
quotes.flavor: As the druids had devoted their lives to preserving Dominaria, so did they devote their deaths.

quotes.name: Forest
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: You know that hiexel bark produces a lot of smoke when burned, but why would Rilsa Rael need so much of it?

quotes.name: Soul's Fire
quotes.flavor: An avatar he sculpts of anger and flame.

quotes.name: Amrou Seekers
quotes.flavor: The paradise of Amrou Haven had become a field of cinders. Its people struggled to survive, hoping to see visions of its past in the strange storms that quickly passed.

quotes.name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
quotes.flavor:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

quotes.name: Fencer's Magemark
quotes.flavor:
"The first blow is the most important. It often negates the need for a second."
—Agrus Kos

quotes.name: Lila, Hospitality Hostess
quotes.flavor: As far as Lila was concerned, all courtesy should be common.

quotes.name: Kami of the Crescent Moon
quotes.flavor:
"He's a lot like me, that masterless little kami . . . unimpressed by grandeur and never at a loss for a trick."
—Toshiro Umezawa

quotes.name: Craw Giant
quotes.flavor: Harthag gave a jolly laugh as he surveyed the army before him. "Ho ho ho! Midgets! You think you can stand in my way?"

quotes.name: Echoing Truth
quotes.flavor: A single lie unleashes a tide of disbelief.

quotes.name: Mana Geyser
quotes.flavor: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

quotes.name: Hemlock Vial
quotes.flavor: Just what the doctor ordered.

quotes.name: Boros Signet
quotes.flavor: Carved high into stone, the signet requires all to look up at it—whether with fear or admiration.

quotes.name: Chastise
quotes.flavor:
"Why do we pray to the Ancestor? Because She listens."
—Mystic elder

quotes.name: Blazing Archon
quotes.flavor:
"Through the haze of battle I saw the glint of sun on golden mane, the sheen of glory clad in mail, and I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war."
—Dravin, Gruul deserter

quotes.name: Vault of the Archangel
quotes.flavor:
"For centuries my creation kept this world in balance. Now only her shadow remains."
—Sorin Markov

quotes.name: Exalted Dragon
quotes.flavor: If dragons excel at anything more than vanity, it is greed.

quotes.name: Nocturnal Feeder
quotes.flavor: A living pulse is an irresistible temptation.

quotes.name: Dragonfire Blade
quotes.flavor: Dragon's scales to adorn the hilt, dragon's bones to polish the blade, and dragon's breath to kindle its edge.

quotes.name: Fendeep Summoner
quotes.flavor: "What is drowned is not forgotten. I will fulfill my oath. Come back to me, my brethren, as I have come back for you."

quotes.name: Greater Mossdog
quotes.flavor: Man's best fungus.

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.flavor:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

quotes.name: Despark
quotes.flavor:
「屈辱を受けてすべての力を失った暴君の話？ それだけで刺激的だよ！」
——シルバークイルの魔道生徒、キリアン

quotes.name: Octoprophet
quotes.flavor: In every swirl of the tide, it sees the awakening of things yet to come.

quotes.name: Deeproot Elite
quotes.flavor: "You think I stand alone? I have the forest at my call, the waters at my back. I outnumber you."

quotes.name: Revive
quotes.flavor: Even what is lost beyond recall returns when coaxed by a dryad's hand.

quotes.name: Ill-Tempered Cyclops
quotes.flavor: A cyclops has two moods: angry and asleep.

quotes.name: Raise the Palisade
quotes.flavor: And just like that, the vibe went from "keep out" to cookout.

quotes.name: My First Tome
quotes.flavor: This card is named My First Tome.

quotes.name: Valgavoth's Onslaught
quotes.flavor: Tyvar and the Wanderer were done running.

quotes.name: Dune-Brood Nephilim
quotes.flavor: When it awoke, it spawned nameless thousands to herald its arrival.

quotes.name: Verduran Enchantress
quotes.flavor: Some say magic was first practiced by women, who have always felt strong ties to the land.

quotes.name: Wizened Mentor
quotes.flavor: It wasn't that his students were better; it was that his students had made *him* better.

quotes.name: Hunter's Blowgun
quotes.flavor:
"Ow! I think a wasp just stung me, cap'n."
—Nirk Doobin, last words

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor:
"Magic rings are, well, magical; and they are rare and curious."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Ravenous Chupacabra
quotes.flavor: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

quotes.name: Gloom Sower
quotes.flavor:
"First, the darkness fell. Terror came next. After that, only despair remained."
—*The Tragedy of Morein*

quotes.name: Mechanized Warfare
quotes.flavor: First the automatons reinforced depleted squads. Then they replaced them entirely.

quotes.name: Impolite Entrance
quotes.flavor: "We smelled you kith-twits makin' porridge in here! We love porridge! Give us your porridge!"

quotes.name: Boots of Speed
quotes.flavor: Click your heels and become the wind.

quotes.name: Ultimate Green Goblin
quotes.flavor: Osborn's lust for power was nothing short of monstrous.

quotes.name: Outland Boar
quotes.flavor: The vibrant forest of Peema is awash with aether. Its animals are stronger, faster, and more aggressive than their counterparts elsewhere.

quotes.name: Thornglint Bridge
quotes.flavor: The path to growth is forged in balance.

quotes.name: Temple Garden
quotes.flavor: The kithkin was admiring the flowers when the skies darkened, then they ripped up the roots for the next season.

quotes.name: Vampiric Tutor
quotes.flavor:
"I write upon clean white parchment with a sharp quill and the blood of my students, divining their secrets."
—Shauku, Endbringer

quotes.name: Sage of the Unknowable
quotes.flavor: "Someday, we will walk the Blind Eternities and see the truths that lie beyond the stifling veil of reality."

quotes.name: Relentless Assault
quotes.flavor: With only 70,000 men under his command at the battle of Guandu, Cao Cao was able to defeat Yuan Shao and his 700,000.

quotes.name: Friendly Fire
quotes.flavor:
"Never tell goblins to 'fire at will.'"
—Urut Barzeel, Mardu hordechief

quotes.name: Karakyk Guardian
quotes.flavor: Only Temur whisperers are allowed in the Dragon's Throat. All others must justify their presence to the valley's guardian.

quotes.name: Cosmic Spider-Man
quotes.flavor: The Enigma Force granted Peter the greatest power, and with it, the greatest responsibility.

quotes.name: Deputy of Acquittals
quotes.flavor: "Everyone deserves a day in court."

quotes.name: Emerald Dragonfly
quotes.flavor: "Flittering, wheeling, / darting in to strike, and then / gone just as you blink." —"Dragonfly Haiku," poet unknown

quotes.name: Nightmare
quotes.flavor: The Nightmare arises from its lair in the swamps. As the poisoned land spreads, so does the Nightmare's rage and terrifying strength.

quotes.name: Ghostly Flame
quotes.flavor:
"Walk slowly when in the nether world, and seek that which calls."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Hunger of the Howlpack
quotes.flavor:
"Werewolves are an unholy mix of a predator's instinct and a human's hatred."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

quotes.name: The Lady of the Mountain
quotes.flavor: Her given name has been lost in the mists of time. Legend says that her silent vigil will one day be ended by the one who, pure of heart and spirit, calls out that name again.

quotes.name: Loran of the Third Path
quotes.flavor: As a scholar, she saw the sylex not as a weapon, but as a key to the past.

quotes.name: Retaliation
quotes.flavor: A foul, metallic stench clogged Urza's senses. It was then he knew his brother was no more.

quotes.name: Aether Flash
quotes.flavor: As the foul beast appeared, arcane lightning crackled around it.

quotes.name: Knight of the White Orchid
quotes.flavor: Both guide and guard on open plain.

quotes.name: Corrupt
quotes.flavor: "Most wise, most thoughtful, most powerful qadir," said the Gixian, "we offer whatever help we may give in your illustrious name."

quotes.name: Death Begets Life
quotes.flavor:
"You need not mourn. Their life essence has returned to the earth, where it will eventually bloom into a new form."
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper

quotes.name: Eager Construct
quotes.flavor: Loyal to a fault, it anticipates its master's every need.

quotes.name: Amethyst Dragon // Explosive Crystal
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"At least it's a beautiful way to die."
—Erinis, gloom stalker

quotes.name: Tajuru Pathwarden
quotes.flavor: "My people blazed these pathways long ago, before the Eldrazi came. We will ride them long after the Eldrazi are gone."

quotes.name: It That Betrays
quotes.flavor: All will be harvested.

quotes.name: Crisis of Conscience
quotes.flavor: "Just touch these two strands together and the Daleks are finished. Have I that right?"

quotes.name: Ixalli's Lorekeeper
quotes.flavor: "Did we follow the dinosaurs out of the caverns, or did they follow us? These glyphs could change our entire understanding of our history."

quotes.name: Puppet Strings
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor: "Have no illusions," Volrath warned Greven, "about free will."

quotes.name: Skybridge Towers
quotes.flavor: New Capenna's districts are a series of tiers; wealth and power always rise to the top.

quotes.name: Mirari's Wake
quotes.flavor: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.

quotes.name: Avenger of Zendikar
quotes.flavor: Vengeance is a brew best served chilled.

quotes.name: Speakeasy Server
quotes.flavor: "Whatever ails you, friends, this will cure it for tonight! And leave you with a little inspiration for tomorrow."

quotes.name: Sol'kanar the Swamp King
quotes.flavor:
"All the power of a maro-sorcerer, all the mindless fury of a pitlord. He is a perfect servant."
—Geyadrone Dihada

quotes.name: Terminate
quotes.flavor: "I think, therefore I annihilate!"

quotes.name: Scepter of Empires
quotes.flavor:
"With this scepter, smite your enemies."
—Scepter inscription

quotes.name: Fanatical Devotion
quotes.flavor: The Oracle told Eladamri he would save his people by abandoning them. His followers adopted that ideal.

quotes.name: Treasure Vault
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: There is wealth enough inside to cause the rise and the ruin of dynasties.

quotes.name: Transmogrant Altar
quotes.flavor:
"The human body—like any other machine—can be stripped for parts."
—Ashnod

quotes.name: Tangled Colony
quotes.flavor: Clawing for scraps and driven mad by hunger, the individual rats became a writhing mass.

quotes.name: Vernal Fen
quotes.flavor:
"You are here because the outside world rejects you. The Foot is your family. I am your father."
—Shredder

quotes.name: Falkenrath Torturer
quotes.flavor: "There was a time when our cages rang with wailing. Now only a handful of these whimpering fools remain."

quotes.name: Reduce to Ashes
quotes.flavor:
"Before they can go to their final rest, the wicked must be purified by fire."
—Harra the Adjudicator

quotes.name: Warbeast of Gorgoroth
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Drums rolled, fires leaped, and great engines drawn by beasts crawled across the field.

quotes.name: Esper Origins // Summon: Esper Maduin
quotes.flavor: "I've chosen a name for her . . . Terra."

quotes.name: Dictate of the Twin Gods
quotes.flavor: Iroas and Mogis are as different in appearance as they are in personality.

quotes.name: Colossal Majesty
quotes.flavor:
"Might doesn't just build empires. It protects them."
—Inti, Sun Empire knight

quotes.name: Firebreathing
quotes.flavor: The mage breathed in life-giving air and breathed out death-bringing fire.

quotes.name: Arc Trail
quotes.flavor:
"Don't try to hit your enemies. Concentrate on the space between them, and fill the air with doom."
—Spear-Tribe teaching

quotes.name: Distant Memories
quotes.flavor:
"The fleeting shadows of his primitive self have all but vanished."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

quotes.name: Subterranean Tremors
quotes.flavor: The market is now closed.

quotes.name: Meddling Mage
quotes.flavor: Meddling mages chant so loudly that no one can get a spell in edgewise.

quotes.name: Castle Embereth
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Without Embereth's courage, the realm would falter and fall.

quotes.name: Wonder
quotes.flavor:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—Scroll of Beginnings

quotes.name: Shuri, the Black Panther
quotes.flavor: "Monster! You've faced the muscle of Wakanda. Now face its claws."

quotes.name: Giant Spider
quotes.flavor:
Watching the spider's web
—Llanowar expression meaning "focusing on the wrong thing"

quotes.name: Armored Griffin
quotes.flavor: When an order for griffin barding comes in, blacksmiths prepare their forges for months of exacting work. They know griffins always detect imperfections and never haggle.

quotes.name: Greater Werewolf
quotes.flavor:
"Two legs by day, four legs by night, eyes raging in storm-gotten might."
—Ancient Northland riddle

quotes.name: Ohran Yeti
quotes.flavor: When a snowdrift shows you its eyes, it's already too late.

quotes.name: Grave Pact
quotes.flavor: Denied the peace of the Blessed Sleep, geists lash out at the living, and the cycle of anger and unrest continues unbroken.

quotes.name: Calculating Lich
quotes.flavor: "We share a common enemy. Does that not make us friends?"

quotes.name: Toxic Deluge
quotes.flavor:
"You must decide what you're willing to give to your spell craft: mana, pest essence, even your own life force. Everything is fair game for a resourceful mage."
—Willowdusk

quotes.name: Foresee
quotes.flavor: Wind time's watch, and watch time unwind.

quotes.name: Accumulated Knowledge
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen and heard much here. There are secrets within secrets. Let me show you."
—Takara, to Eladamri

quotes.name: Unburial Rites
quotes.flavor: All crave the Blessed Sleep. Few receive it.

quotes.name: Body Dropper
quotes.flavor: "Kill count? I lost track years ago."

quotes.name: Skaab Wrangler
quotes.flavor: After Uda's hat boutique in Selhoff was destroyed by werewolves, she relocated outside of town and took up a new type of sewing.

quotes.name: Elvish Mystic
quotes.flavor: "I ask you, one who has returned to arms of nature, what dreams await in the slumber of death?"

quotes.name: March from the Tomb
quotes.flavor: They came from all walks of life, from every part of Zendikar, and they returned with one unifying cause.

quotes.name: Full Moon's Rise
quotes.flavor: Some lycanthropes wish they could abandon their weak human shapes and revel in the power of the wolf.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

quotes.name: Plated Rootwalla
quotes.flavor:
" . . . And the third little boar built his house out of rootwalla plates . . . ."
—Skyshroud children's story

quotes.name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
quotes.flavor: Spilled blood always begets more of the same.

quotes.name: Abuelo's Awakening
quotes.flavor: Quintorius touched the old poncho he'd found. A rush of magic condensed into an Echo, and wise Abuelo stepped forth.

quotes.name: Naiad of Hidden Coves
quotes.flavor:
"Wave-borne, he watches over secrets of the shore."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

quotes.name: Price of Freedom
quotes.flavor:
"We're going to win a great victory against the Fire Nation today."
—Jet

quotes.name: Bushmeat Poacher
quotes.flavor: "If you've never feasted on Zagoth terror-pig, I got the best price you'll find."

quotes.name: Bag of Holding
quotes.flavor: There's no prepared like overprepared.

quotes.name: Stormblood Berserker
quotes.flavor: Blood is holy to those whose god is War.

quotes.name: Delusions of Mediocrity
quotes.flavor: When nothing but second best will do.

quotes.name: Survey the Wreckage
quotes.flavor: Goblins and architects seldom get along.

quotes.name: Scuttling Sliver
quotes.flavor: A living fossil active after eons of dormancy.

quotes.name: Root Maze
quotes.flavor:
"We should step up repairs. I think the forest has plans for us."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Sparktongue Dragon
quotes.flavor: Fools believe that Kolaghan's brood follows lightning storms. The wise know that it is the other way around.

quotes.name: Accomplished Alchemist
quotes.flavor: "Tincture of murkroot and lizard feet? Simple. One that doesn't taste like murkroot and lizard feet? I'm working on it."

quotes.name: Ridgetop Raptor
quotes.flavor:
"The Skirk Ridge has many wonderful things to discover—like escape routes."
—Foothill guide

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

quotes.name: Skyknight Vanguard
quotes.flavor: "Jump! NOW!"

quotes.name: Immaculate Magistrate
quotes.flavor: Elves of the immaculate class weave flora into living creatures—sometimes to endorse an elite warrior, sometimes to create a breathing work of art.

quotes.name: Air Elemental
quotes.flavor: These spirits of the air are winsome and wild and cannot be truly contained. Only marginally intelligent, they often substitute whimsy for strategy, delighting in mischief and mayhem.

quotes.name: Red Death, Shipwrecker
quotes.flavor:
"That little fella is deadly in his own fashion."
—The Mariner

quotes.name: Droning Bureaucrats
quotes.flavor: " . . . and you must also apply for an application license, file documents 136(iv) and 22-C and -D in triplicate, pay all requisite fees, request a . . ."

quotes.name: Flawless Maneuver
quotes.flavor:
"Captain, your units are the tip of our spear. There is zero room for failure."
—Jirina Kudro

quotes.name: Goblin General
quotes.flavor: Lead, follow, or run around like crazy.

quotes.name: Torch Fiend
quotes.flavor: Devils redecorate every room with fire.

quotes.name: Cleansing Nova
quotes.flavor: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

quotes.name: Hookhand Mariner // Riphook Raider
quotes.flavor: They weren't entirely wrong.

quotes.name: Markov Dreadknight
quotes.flavor: The destruction of Markov Manor made the surviving members of the bloodline more dangerous.

quotes.name: Sunset Saboteur
quotes.flavor: "Lightsick fools. All suns eventually set."

quotes.name: Renegade Map
quotes.flavor: "We have safe houses in every zone, but you'll never find one without this."

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.
